title: Police identify man shot by RCMP near Crescent Beach
article: Vancouver Police have identified a man shot to death by Surrey RCMP Wednesday as 23-year-old Brendon Beddow.
Beddow has had minor run-ins with the law according to the provincial court data base.
He faced possession charges and a trafficking count and had three outstanding charges of driving while prohibited at the time of the shooting. He was due back in court April 19.
Beddow was fatally wounded after Surrey RCMP got called to a residence near in the 3000-block of McBride, near Crescent Beach, about an domestic dispute Wednesday.

'The Vancouver Police are conducting the investigation into incident at the request of the Surrey detachment of the RCMP,' Const. Lindsey Houghton said Thursday. 'VPD Major Crime detectives will be back in the neighbourhood today to locate and speak with witnesses.
Anyone who has pertinent information about the incident is asked to contact the Vancouver Police Homicide Squad at 604-717-2500.'
